scope: Supplemental runtime smoke test in Linux amd64 containers on a macOS ARM64 Docker Desktop host; not a build path or bare-metal acceptance

artifact.source: Previously built neutral Webman plugin distribution
artifact.containerSetup: Read-only bind mount of the existing distribution, copied into each disposable container; only the copied config/process.php listen address changed from 127.0.0.1:18781 to 0.0.0.0:18781 for loopback-only Docker port forwarding

saiAdmin.isolation: Each disposable container used --network none, with no external database or port publishing. Only its copied config/process.php worker count changed from cpu_count() * 4 to 1.

centos7.captcha: GET /core/captcha: HTTP 200; JSON code 200, message success, data keys image/result/uuid

ubuntu2204.captcha: GET /core/captcha: JSON code 200, message success, data keys image/result/uuid

alibabaCloudLinux3.captcha: GET /core/captcha: JSON code 200, message success, data keys image/result/uuid

alibabaCloudLinux4.captcha: GET /core/captcha: JSON code 200, message success, data keys image/result/uuid

saiAdmin.runtimeNotices: Existing PHP deprecation notices from Carbon, Think Collection, Webman Finder and Brick Math appeared during startup; they did not prevent startup or the captcha response.

cleanup.testContainers: All named and anonymous --rm containers were stopped or exited; docker ps -a returned no containers before and after image removal.
cleanup.dockerDesktop: Left running because absence of dependencies from other tasks was not established.

limits: All containers share Docker Desktop's LinuxKit kernel, not each distribution's bare-metal kernel.
amd64 execution on the macOS ARM64 host is emulated.
SaiAdmin login, user information, permission denial and ordinary-PHP comparison were not tested in this matrix because no isolated database was provisioned for this test.
CentOS 7 official container image is historical and end-of-life; this smoke test does not establish maintained-server support.
Required CentOS 7, Alibaba Cloud Linux 3/4, and Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal acceptance remains open.
